answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a fleet in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The vault cap is applied at intake and ferrous makes public the per-origin counts. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a gale tag. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
